To be trusted stewards of Ohio’s Treasury, wise investors in Ohio’s future, and bold innovators committed to improving people’s lives.
Mission Statement
NEW FROM THE OHIO TREASURER'S OFFICE
MEET TREASURER SPRAGUE
Robert Sprague currently serves as Ohio’s 49th Treasurer of State. As Treasurer, he is the chief investment officer for the state’s investment and debt portfolios, oversees the daily cash flows of state monies, and serves as custodian of certain funds and investment assets outside the state treasury.
Read More >>

Securing the Future of Public Finance
Registration is now open for the 2026 CPIM Conference on Thursday, November 5, in Westerville. Attend CPIM eligible sessions, hear from industry experts, and connect with fellow fiscal officers.
Read More >>
INTRODUCING THE NEW STABLE ACCOUNT ENROLLMENT INCENTIVE
Eligible Ohioans opening a STABLE Account will receive a match on the first $25 deposited into their account.
Read More >>
HELPING OHIO SMALL BUSINESS OWNERS ACCESS LOW-COST CAPITAL
The new Buckeye Business Advantage program allows for reduced-interest loans through participating financial institutions to eligible small business owners across Ohio. Applications are now being accepted.
Read More >>
TAKE THE NEXT STEP ON YOUR HOMEBUYING JOURNEY
New Ohio Homebuyer Plus savings program to provide enhanced interest earnings to prospective homebuyers.
Read More >>
Ag-LINK application window now open
Through Ag-LINK, farm operators, agribusinesses, and co-ops can receive up to a 3% interest rate reduction on new or existing operating loans.
Read More >>
INAUGURAL PILOT PROJECT EXCEEDS KEY METRICS; DEMONSTRATES SUCCESS
Two-year effort conducted under the ResultsOHIO framework becomes the first completed state-supported pay for success project in Ohio.
Read More >>
FINANCIAL EDUCATION AND EMPOWERMENT
The Treasurer’s office is committed to providing information and resources to help Ohioans secure a sound financial future. Through a series of initiatives, we are working to increase awareness and access to the many great financial education resources across our state.
Read More >>
New Initiative Aims to Modernize Investment Strategies
The Treasurer’s office is working to invest more of Ohio’s tax dollars in Ohio. The Ohio Gains proposal aims to bolster support for the state’s agriculture community, health systems, and public universities.

Who We Are The treasurer of the U.S. State of Ohio is responsible for collecting and safeguarding taxes and fees, and managing state investments. The Treasury was located in the Ohio Statehouse from 1861 to 1974, when it was moved to the Rhodes State Office Tower.
